title: Finite prime chains contract strictly at one filtered-colimit stage
statement: For a small filtered diagram R of commutative rings, every finite strictly increasing chain of prime ideals in colimit R has a stage where all contractions are prime and strictly increasing.

proof.text: For each ordered pair a < b in the finite chain, choose x in p(b) outside p(a), using SetLike.exists_of_lt. Represent x at a stage by Concrete.colimit_exists_rep, with preservation of filtered colimits by the forgetful functor CommRingCat.FilteredColimits.forget_preservesFilteredColimits.

Apply IsFiltered.sup_objs_exists to the finite set of representing stages and transport each representative along a morphism to the common receiving stage. Naturality colimit.w preserves its image. The empty set when n = 0 is covered by nonemptiness of the filtered category.

Contractions are prime by Ideal.comap_isPrime. For a < b, Ideal.comap_mono gives inclusion and the transported separator belongs to the contraction of p(b) but not that of p(a). Thus the inclusion is strict, establishing StrictMono.

lean.statement: theorem filteredColimit_prime_chain_contraction {I : Type u} [SmallCategory I] [IsFiltered I] (R : I ⥤ CommRingCat.{u}) : ∀ (n : ℕ) (p : Fin (n + 1) → Ideal (colimit R : CommRingCat.{u})), (∀ j, (p j).IsPrime) → StrictMono p → ∃ i : I, (∀ j, (Ideal.comap (colimit.ι R i).hom (p j)).IsPrime) ∧ StrictMono (fun j ↦ Ideal.comap (colimit.ι R i).hom (p j))
